mechanism: The article list view renders store.articles through a Scroll container holding a Column with a plain ForEach, which is never virtualised; the card grid also uses a non-caching ForEach. Opening a feed or scrolling loads pages of articles (limit grows with 'load more'), and every accumulated article row/card — including off-screen ones — is built eagerly, with per-card context menus bound, slowing list display and paging in large feeds.
fix_summary: Both the list and grid render via LazyForEach over an IDataSource kept in sync with the store, so rows are created on demand as they enter the viewport.

performance_oracle.definition: Sampled retired-instruction period sum (hw-instructions) attributed to the app process in the complete externally driven measured window.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
